about: Camera modes. One row per mode. The render camera (CSCamera.pers_cam_1) is overwritten every frame after CameraStep; the follow camera's yaw is pinned so stick/WASD movement is screen-relative.

pitch_deg.doc: angle below horizontal; Dungeons is steep

yaw_deg.doc: fixed world yaw; 45 gives the Dungeons diagonal

target_height_m.doc: look-at point above the player's feet

ceiling_mode.doc: shorten = ray-cast from player to camera and pull in under ceilings (caves, catacombs, legacy dungeons)
